name: cross_border_unified_ontology
displayName: 跨境供应链统一 Ontology（控制塔 + SKU 准入 + 费用对账 + 采购三方对账 + 仓储库存，五场景共享）
scope: Five scenarios on one ontology: (1) delay-risk control tower; (2) SKU admission & quote decision; (3) invoice reconciliation & cost anomaly loop; (4) procurement three-way match (PO line / goods receipt / supplier invoice); (5) warehouse inventory accuracy (Warehouse / InventoryPosition / InventoryReservation / CycleCount) — all REUSING the RiskEvent/Task closed loop (F1/P1/W1). Shared objects zero duplication.
authority: Human-readable sources: control-tower-ontology-manual.md (v0.2) + admission-manual-v0.3.md + cost-manual-v0.4.md. Decisions D1-D11, E1-E5, F1-F5, P1-P3, W1 govern changes. W1 adds the warehouse domain (Warehouse, InventoryPosition, InventoryReservation, CycleCount, rules R16-R18). P3 adds procurement sourcing (RFQ, RFQLine, Quote, rules R14 single_source / R15 maverick_spend); Build A = model+data+engine only (actions A17-A19 are placeholders, RFQ/Quote via standard view). Filename kept for reference stability.

asOfPolicy.rule: All engine evaluation and UI rendering take an explicit as_of_date parameter. Implicit system time is forbidden (D8).

rules: All object instances must use a stable unique primary key.
Do not use any mutable display name as a primary key.
Synthetic keys must be generated in the data preparation layer and persisted before application usage.

sensitiveFieldRules.rendering: Fields hidden by permission must render as 'no access', never as blank/null. null must not be interpreted as 'no risk'.

objects.description: P1: purchase-order line. Covers D2's single-SKU-PO constraint — a PO can now hold multiple SKUs, batch receipts, and line-level three-way match. Child of the existing PurchaseOrder (po_id fk); no new PO-header object.

properties.name: po_id
properties.description: References existing purchase_orders.po_id (reuse, not a new header).

properties.name: sku_id
properties.description: One-PO-one-supplier invariant: every line's SKU belongs to the PO's supplier.

properties.name: qty
properties.description: Authoritative ordered quantity for the line (overrides the legacy single-SKU PO header qty).

properties.name: unit_price_usd
properties.description: Agreed PO unit price; basis for R10 price mismatch.

properties.name: expected_ready_date
properties.description: Line-level supplier ready date; basis for R7 delay. Sampled independently of the PO header date (audit view needs line-level timing control).

properties.name: as_of_date
properties.description: Explicit simulation snapshot (D8).

objects.description: P1: goods receipt note (GRN). One PO may have multiple GRNs (batch receiving); each GRN carries a received_date.

properties.name: received_date
properties.description: Compared with PoLine.expected_ready_date for R7.

objects.description: P1: per-line receipt against a PoLine. received/accepted/rejected + QC outcome drive R8 (short receipt) and R9 (QC failure); per-line received_date drives R7 (supplier delay) at row granularity.

properties.name: received_qty
properties.description: R8: sum(received_qty) per po_line < qty (beyond tolerance) = short receipt.

properties.name: rejected_qty
properties.description: received - accepted.

properties.name: qc_status
properties.description: R9: failed = QC reject.

properties.name: defect_ppm
properties.description: R9: defect_ppm > config threshold also flags QC even when not fully failed.

properties.name: received_date
properties.description: R7: per-line actual receipt date. Batched GRNs receive lines on different days; using this row-level date (not the GRN header min) lets an injected-late line in a multi-line PO be detected instead of being masked by an on-time sibling.

objects.description: P1: supplier AP invoice, INDEPENDENT object (not the freight Invoice) so the cost-reconciliation scenario stays clean. Basis for R10 three-way match against PO and GRN.

properties.name: vendor_invoice_no
properties.description: Supplier's own number; real-world reconciliation key.

properties.name: total_usd
properties.description: Must equal sum of line amounts (DQ).

objects.description: P1: per-line supplier invoice charge against a PoLine. unit_price vs PoLine.unit_price drives R10 (price/qty mismatch).

properties.name: unit_price_usd
properties.description: R10: |unit_price - po_line.unit_price| / po_line.unit_price > config.price_tol.

properties.name: amount_usd
properties.description: qty x unit_price (DQ).

objects.description: P2 (procurement enrichment): a payment milestone against a PurchaseOrder (deposit / balance / full). Deposit paid before goods arrive creates prepayment exposure — the money-out leg the three-way match (PO/GRN/invoice) alone cannot see. Basis for R12.

properties.name: po_id
properties.description: References existing purchase_orders.po_id (payment attaches to the PO header, not a line).

properties.name: payment_type
properties.description: Deposit is the prepayment leg R12 watches; balance/full follow receipt.

properties.name: amount_usd
properties.description: Cash paid; for a deposit this is the exposure at risk until goods are received.

properties.name: paid_date
properties.description: R12: exposure age = as_of_date - paid_date, compared with config.deposit_grace_days.

properties.name: exposure_status
properties.description: Denormalized hint only. Detection (R12) NEVER trusts this field — it recomputes from receipts + paid_date (same 'do not trust status fields' rule as pipeline shipment state).

properties.name: as_of_date
properties.description: Explicit simulation snapshot (D8).

objects.description: P2 (procurement enrichment): a supplier certificate/qualification with a validity window (factory audit, ISO9001, UFLPA traceability, product safety). An expired qualification on a supplier that still has open POs is a live compliance exposure. Basis for R13.

properties.name: supplier_id
properties.description: References existing suppliers.supplier_id.

properties.name: cert_type
properties.description: e.g. factory_audit, iso9001, uflpa_traceability, product_safety_cert. Severity of R13 depends on cert_type.

properties.name: valid_to
properties.description: R13: valid_to < as_of_date (expired) with no same-cert_type renewal covering as_of. valid_to within [as_of, as_of+config.qual_expiring_days] is 'expiring', NOT yet expired.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Denormalized hint only. Detection (R13) recomputes from valid_from/valid_to vs as_of_date; does not trust this field.

properties.name: as_of_date
properties.description: Explicit simulation snapshot (D8).

objects.description: W1 (warehouse domain): a fulfillment/storage node. Why: inventory lives somewhere; SKU availability, ATP and cycle counts are all warehouse-scoped, so the warehouse is a first-class object. type covers the cross-border network shapes (domestic DC / bonded / FBA / 3PL / overseas). Reuses the existing shipment.destination_warehouse ids (LAX-DC1/ONT-DC2/RIV-DC3) so 'goods land in a warehouse' is a real link.

properties.name: operator
properties.description: Who runs it (self / 3PL name / amazon).

properties.name: capacity_units

properties.name: as_of_date
properties.description: Explicit simulation snapshot (D8).

objects.description: W1: on-hand stock of one SKU in one warehouse (grain = SKU x warehouse, decision W1; not lot, so R21 batch-expiry is deferred). Why buckets: real inventory splits into available / reserved / in_transit / quarantine; ATP (available-to-promise) = available + in_transit - reserved is what fulfillment can actually promise. safety_stock is the R16 floor.

properties.name: sku_id
properties.description: References catalog SKU.

properties.name: available_qty
properties.description: On-hand, sellable now. R16: available_qty <= safety_stock = stockout.

properties.name: reserved_qty
properties.description: Committed to allocated reservations; subtracted in ATP.

properties.name: in_transit_qty
properties.description: Inbound not yet received; added in ATP.

properties.name: quarantine_qty
properties.description: Held (QC/damage); not sellable, excluded from ATP.

properties.name: safety_stock
properties.description: R16 floor; config.warehouse.safety_stock_range.

properties.name: as_of_date
properties.description: Explicit simulation snapshot (D8).

dataQualityRules: at most one position per (sku_id, warehouse_id)

objects.description: W1: a demand claim tying a SalesOrderLine to an InventoryPosition. Why: it makes 'can this order be fulfilled from this warehouse?' an object. An open reservation whose position ATP < its qty is R17 (unfulfillable). Detection computes ATP from position buckets, NOT from reservations, to avoid a circular dependency.

properties.name: so_line_id
properties.description: The demand: a SalesOrderLine (same object as the control tower).

properties.name: qty
properties.description: Ordered/needed quantity; R17 compares it against position ATP.

properties.name: as_of_date
properties.description: Explicit simulation snapshot (D8).

objects.description: W1: a physical count of an InventoryPosition vs the system book qty. Why: inventory record accuracy (IRA) is the warehouse's core health metric; the gap between counted and system is shrinkage. |counted - system| / system > tol (equivalently IRA < ira_target) is R18.

properties.name: system_qty
properties.description: Book quantity at count time.

properties.name: counted_qty
properties.description: Physically counted quantity.

properties.name: variance
properties.description: counted - system (negative = shrink).

properties.name: as_of_date
properties.description: Explicit simulation snapshot (D8).

objects.description: P3: a request-for-quote to source a SKU. Why: an awarded RFQ certifies an additional approved supplier for the SKU, so the RFQ/Quote history IS the approved-vendor list (many-to-many) the catalog's single supplier_id cannot express. Single approved source drives R14; initiate_second_source (Build B) opens one.

properties.name: created_date

objects.description: P3: the sourced line of an RFQ (the SKU and quantity being quoted). Child of RFQ; keeps the RFQ header/line split consistent with PO/PoLine and Invoice/InvoiceLine.

properties.name: qty
properties.description: Requested sourcing quantity.

objects.description: P3: a supplier's quote against an RFQ. Why: a Quote in status 'awarded' certifies that supplier as an approved source for the RFQ's SKU (the AVL entry). R14 (single source) and R15 (maverick / approved-alternate exemption) both read awarded quotes.

properties.description: Explicit simulation snapshot (D8).

objects.description: Coordination Loop (decision CL1): a tracked outbound coordination with an external counterparty (supplier/forwarder/customs_broker/bank/customer) that handling a RiskEvent requires. Why: today a delay Task says 'expedite', but the real work is chasing the factory for a revised ready date or the customer for a split-ship acceptance -- that ask -> follow-up -> response -> escalate back-and-forth is real operational state the control tower must hold, not fire-and-forget. Anchored on the Task that spawned it (task_id) with a redundant risk_event_id anchor so a thread joins straight back to the risk graph. overdue is DERIVED (state in {awaiting,escalated} and next_action_due < as_of), never a stored field.

properties.name: task_id
properties.description: Anchor Task that this coordination serves (the mitigation being worked).

properties.name: risk_event_id
properties.description: Redundant anchor to the Task's RiskEvent, so a thread joins straight back to the risk graph.

properties.name: counterparty_ref
properties.description: Free-text handle for the counterparty (e.g. supplier id/name, forwarder, broker).

properties.name: ask
properties.description: What we need from the counterparty (e.g. 'confirm revised ready date after reschedule').

properties.name: followup_count
properties.description: How many outreach touches sent (starts at 1 on open, ++ on each record_outreach).

properties.name: escalation_level
properties.description: 0 initially; ++ on each escalate_coordination.

properties.name: owner
properties.description: Internal owner chasing this thread (demo roster id).

properties.name: next_action_due
properties.description: When the next internal action is due; basis for the DERIVED overdue flag (explicit as_of, D8).

properties.name: last_response
properties.description: Latest counterparty response text; null until record_response.

properties.name: outcome
properties.description: Terminal outcome text; null until resolve/mark_dead_ended.

properties.name: opened_at
properties.description: as_of when opened (D8).

properties.name: last_update
properties.description: as_of of the last state change (D8).

properties.name: policy_version
properties.description: Marks demo-seeded threads for idempotent re-seed cleanup; runtime threads carry a runtime marker.

Shipment.notes: departed state removed (D9/C5). delayed is a derived flag, not a state.

transitions.notes: 补资料回流，非终态（同 C1 思想）

AdmissionCase.notes: Terminal: approved / quote_with_conditions / rejected. quote_with_conditions promoted to a status (N3).

Invoice.notes: Terminal: disputed (handed to claims process) / approved (pay as billed).

InventoryReservation.notes: W1 Build 1 defines states; ReserveInventory/ReleaseReservation land in Build 2/3.

CycleCount.notes: W1 Build 1 defines states; RecordCycleCount/AdjustInventory land in Build 2/3.

transitions.trigger: award to a supplier (certifies approved source)

RFQ.notes: P3 Build A defines states; initiate_second_source (Build B) creates a draft RFQ to remediate R14. An awarded RFQ certifies an additional approved supplier for the SKU.

Quote.notes: P3 Build A defines states. status='awarded' is the AVL entry read by R14 (single source) and R15 (approved-alternate exemption).

CoordinationThread.notes: Coordination Loop (decision CL1). Terminal: resolved, dead_ended. overdue is DERIVED (state in {awaiting,escalated} and next_action_due < as_of), not a state. Actions gated by new COORD_PERMS.ManageCoordination = {ops,cs,procurement,finance}, an independent permission group -- maker-checker ROLE_PERMS unchanged (ApproveMitigation stays manager-only, CloseRiskEvent stays ops-only).

aiQueryTools.description: 列出发票（v0.4），可按 status 过滤（received/under_review/approved/disputed）。返回 invoice_id/vendor/type/shipment/total/status/issue_date

aiQueryTools.name: get_invoice_context
aiQueryTools.description: 查发票完整对账上下文：发票 + 行明细（join expected_costs 给出基准与差异列）+ 所属 shipment 摘要（incoterm/delay_days/status）。发票金额字段按角色脱敏（与 UI 费用工作台 mask_cost 同规：finance/manager 可见，其余掩码）

aiQueryTools.name: get_similar_resolutions
aiQueryTools.description: C1 只读检索处置记忆：按规则类型精确匹配+同航线（origin→destination LOCODE）查同类风险的历史处置——同类 N 次、按方案/决定的统计、最相似 1 案详情（当时提案/人的决定/实际结果/质量标签）。所有数字运行时从 resolution_memory 现算可回查；无先例如实返回首例；被屏蔽（voided）的记忆不返回

aiQueryTools.name: explain_relationship_path
aiQueryTools.description: 只读查询 object_relationships：解释两个对象之间的有向关系路径

actions.name: IngestMilestone
actions.signature: ingest_milestone(shipment_id, event_type, event_time, source_system, new_eta=None, payload=None, as_of_date=...) -> Result
preconditions: exact duplicate -> store with is_duplicate=true and skip ALL side effects
successEffects: if event_time newer than last applied: update eta_current / customs_status / state transition
trigger risk detection for shipment as_of event date
failureHandling: illegal transition -> store event, no transition, return warning, count in DQ report

actions.name: CreateRiskEvent
actions.signature: create_risk_event(shipment_id, rule_id, type, severity, affected_so_line_ids, root_cause, as_of_date, actor='system') -> Result
preconditions: existing non-terminal (shipment,type) event -> merge (max severity, union lines), return existing id
failureHandling: line without allocation to shipment -> reject

actions.name: AssignTask
actions.tool_description: 为 open 状态的风险派发处置任务（A3）。这是允许 AI 执行的写动作之一
actions.signature: assign_task(risk_event_id, assignee_role, priority, due_at, actor) -> Result
preconditions: no non-terminal task for this risk
failureHandling: existing non-terminal task -> reject, return its id

actions.name: ProposeMitigation
actions.tool_description: 对 assigned 状态的任务提交处置提案（A4），最终须人工审批。proposal-only 的体现
actions.signature: propose_mitigation(task_id, proposed_action, proposal_params, actor, role) -> Result
actions.executorsNote: v0.4 (P3): executors extended to ops/cs/finance; cost proposals belong to finance. v0.5 (P1): procurement proposals (expedite_po/raise_supplier_claim -> ops; dispute_supplier_invoice -> finance; accept_receipt_variance -> ops). Params schema only; wiring lands in Build 2.
failureHandling: schema validation fails -> reject, task unchanged

actions.name: ApproveMitigation
actions.signature: approve_mitigation(task_id, decision, comment, actor, role='manager') -> Result
preconditions: M1 maker-checker: if proposer actor is known, approver actor_id must differ from proposal_actor_id
failureHandling: non-manager caller -> reject AND audit the violation attempt
same proposer/approver actor -> reject AND audit maker-checker violation
audit: approver actor; maker-checker failures include proposer/approver actor ids

actions.name: CloseRiskEvent
actions.signature: close_risk_event(risk_event_id, outcome, resolution_summary, actor_role) -> Result
preconditions: outcome=false_alarm cancels non-terminal tasks then closes
failureHandling: non-terminal task and outcome != false_alarm -> reject

actions.name: CreateAdmissionCase
actions.tool_description: B1 建案（仅销售）：为 candidate SKU 建准入案。AI 准备动作之一，不做审批
actions.signature: create_admission_case(customer_id, sku_id, request_type, incoterm_candidate, target_launch_date, monthly_order_estimate, actor, role) -> Result
failureHandling: active SKU -> reject (re-review flow is v0.4)

actions.name: RunCompliancePrecheck
actions.tool_description: B2 合规预审（仅合规）：提交 findings 列表，风险等级重算。AI 准备动作，不做审批
actions.signature: run_compliance_precheck(admission_case_id, findings, actor, role) -> Result
failureHandling: schema failure -> reject whole batch, nothing written

actions.name: BuildLogisticsPlan
actions.tool_description: B3 物流方案（仅运营）：建方案，DDP 门禁自动校验。AI 准备动作，不做审批
actions.signature: build_logistics_plan(admission_case_id, plan, actor, role) -> Result
preconditions: DDP gate: customer.ior_capability=has_ior AND exists finding with hts_candidate
failureHandling: DDP missing IOR/HTS -> reject with missing items

actions.name: CalculateCostScenario
actions.tool_description: B4 成本情景（仅财务）：算成本与毛利。AI 准备动作，不做审批/拒接决策
actions.signature: calculate_cost_scenario(logistics_plan_id, scenario, actor, role) -> Result
preconditions: DDP scenario: duty_tax>0 AND customs_brokerage>0 AND risk_buffer>0

actions.name: ApproveQuoteDecision
actions.signature: approve_quote_decision(admission_case_id, approved_logistics_plan_id, approved_cost_scenario_id, decision, decision_reason, conditions, actor, role) -> Result
preconditions: G1: no unresolved critical finding (severity=critical AND evidence_status!=verified)
G2: if approved plan is DDP then customer.ior_capability=has_ior
G3: case=priced AND referenced plan/scenario exist
M1 maker-checker: if selected quote proposer can be inferred, approver actor_id must differ from proposer actor_id
failureHandling: any gate -> reject AND audit (admission-side guardrail assertions)
same inferred proposer/approver actor -> reject AND audit maker-checker violation

actions.name: RejectOrRequestMoreInfo
actions.signature: reject_or_request_more_info(admission_case_id, decision, missing_documents, rejection_reason, actor, role) -> Result

actions.name: RecordGoodsReceipt
actions.signature: record_goods_receipt(po_id, received_date, lines, actor, role, as_of_date=...) -> Result
actions.placeholder: P1 Build 1 defines the shape only; ingest + R7/R8/R9 detection lands in Build 2.
preconditions: each line references a valid po_line_id
successEffects: trigger procurement risk detection (R7/R8/R9) as_of received_date
failureHandling: qty imbalance -> reject and count in DQ

actions.name: MatchSupplierInvoice
actions.signature: match_supplier_invoice(supplier_invoice_id, actor, role, as_of_date=...) -> Result
actions.placeholder: P1 Build 1 defines the shape only; three-way match + R10 detection lands in Build 2.
successEffects: three-way match invoice line vs PoLine vs GoodsReceiptLine
no anomaly -> status=matched/approved; R10 mismatch -> status=under review + CreateRiskEvent
failureHandling: total_usd != sum(lines) -> reject and count in DQ

actions.placeholder: P2 Build A defines the object + R12 detection only. This ingest action (and R12 disposition, e.g. escalate/release prepayment hold) lands in Build B; not implemented in Build A.

riskRules.logic: shipment.eta_current + config.customs_buffer_days + config.lastmile_buffer_days > line.promised_delivery_date (via allocations); skip delivered shipments and fulfilled/cancelled lines
riskRules.severity: per-line: breach<=3d medium, >3d high, tier=A +1 level; event severity = max over affected lines

riskRules.logic: missing_docs non-empty AND (eta_current - as_of_date) < 7d; skip delivered shipments and customs_status=released
status=in_transit AND as_of_date - latest milestone.event_time >= config.stall_days
invoice_line.amount > expected_cost.baseline * (1 + config.rate_tolerance); affected_value = overbilled portion
same (shipment, charge_code, container_no) billed on >1 line across/within invoices; lines beyond first are duplicates
line whose charge_code has no ExpectedCost baseline (DET/DEM/ACC/CHS); DET/DEM on delayed shipments must cite delay attribution in root_cause (F4)
P1: max(goods_receipt.received_date over a po_line's grn_lines) > po_line.expected_ready_date + config.receipt_delay_tol_days. Detection logic lands in Build 2.
P1: sum(grn_line.received_qty) per po_line < po_line.qty * (1 - config.short_qty_tol). Detection logic lands in Build 2.
riskRules.severity: shortfall > 10% of qty: high; else medium

riskRules.logic: P1: any grn_line with qc_status='failed' OR defect_ppm > config.defect_ppm_threshold for a po_line. Detection logic lands in Build 2.
P1: |supplier_invoice_line.unit_price_usd - po_line.unit_price_usd| / po_line.unit_price_usd > config.price_tol (or invoice qty != ordered/received). Detection logic lands in Build 2.

P2: supplier_invoice_line.qty > (sum grn_line.received_qty for the po_line) * (1 + config.invoice_over_qty_tol), AND the line is fully received (received >= po_line.qty * (1 - config.short_qty_tol)) so it is NOT R8's short-receipt domain. Compares invoice vs RECEIVED qty (not accepted): keeps R11 orthogonal to R9 (QC rejection lowers accepted, not received). Anchored on po_line.

P2: a PurchasePayment(payment_type='deposit', paid_date <= as_of) whose PO has NO GoodsReceipt (received_date <= as_of) AND (as_of - paid_date) > config.deposit_grace_days. Money-out with nothing received past grace. Recomputed from receipts+paid_date, never trusting exposure_status. Anchored on po_id.
riskRules.severity: deposit amount_usd > config.exposure_high_usd: high; else medium

riskRules.logic: P2: a Supplier with an open PO (purchase_orders.status != 'closed') that has some cert_type where all SupplierQualifications are expired (valid_to < as_of) and none valid covers as_of (valid_from <= as_of <= valid_to). Expiring (valid_to within [as_of, as_of+config.qual_expiring_days]) is NOT expired. Aggregated to one event per supplier. Anchored on supplier_id.
riskRules.severity: cert_type in {factory_audit, uflpa_traceability}: high; else medium

riskRules.logic: W1: InventoryPosition.available_qty <= safety_stock. Anchored on inventory_position_id (warehouse_id set). affected_value = (safety_stock - available_qty) * sku.unit_price_usd.
riskRules.severity: available_qty <= safety_stock * config.warehouse.stockout_high_frac: high; else medium

riskRules.logic: W1: an open InventoryReservation (status in {open, backordered}) whose SalesOrderLine is open, at a position where ATP < reservation.qty. ATP = available_qty + in_transit_qty - reserved_qty, computed from position buckets (NOT from reservations, to avoid a circular dependency). Anchored on so_line_id (warehouse_id = position.warehouse_id). This is the 'delay -> check on-hand -> substitute' business hook.

W1: a CycleCount where |counted_qty - system_qty| / system_qty > config.warehouse.cycle_count_tol (equivalently IRA < config.warehouse.ira_target). Anchored on cycle_count_id (warehouse_id set). affected_value = |variance| * sku.unit_price_usd.

P3: an active SKU whose approved-supplier set has exactly ONE member AND that sole supplier has a recent R7/R9 RiskEvent (detected_at within config.sourcing.single_source_recent_days of as_of). Approved set = {catalog incumbent (skus.supplier_id)} UNION {suppliers with an awarded Quote (rfq.created_date <= as_of) for the SKU}. A SKU with 2+ approved suppliers is NOT single-source. Reads existing risk_events for R7/R9 (must run after R7-R10); never reads truth. Anchored on supplier_id; sku_id carried in affected_po_line_ids as [sku_id]. affected_value = sum(po_line.qty*unit_price) for the SKU (PO spend exposed to single-source disruption).
riskRules.severity: PO spend exposure > config.sourcing.single_source_high_usd: high; else medium

riskRules.logic: P3: a supplier_invoice whose billing supplier_id != its PO's supplier_id (billed against a PO that is not this supplier's approved PO) AND the billing supplier is NOT an approved alternate source for the invoiced line's SKU (no awarded Quote for the SKU). Off-process / off-contract spend. Existing compliant invoices (supplier == PO supplier) never fire; an approved-alternate biller is exempt (gray). issue_date <= as_of. Anchored on po_id (supplier_id set, affected_invoice_line_ids carries the maverick line). affected_value = invoice total_usd.
riskRules.severity: invoice total_usd > config.sourcing.maverick_high_usd: high; else medium

config.note: Values live in config/*.yaml (procurement.* for R7-R13; warehouse.* for R16-R18; sourcing.* for R14-R15); these are defaults, not hardcoded constants.

incotermRebillMatrix.note: G4 gate (F5/P4): keyed to Shipment.incoterm enum (FOB/CIF/DDP). rebill approval requires affected charge codes within matrix.

rules: every state change has exactly one action_log row
rejected/unauthorized attempts are also logged with failure reason
